item.title: Covalent–Ionic Bonding Regulation Enables Chemo‐Mechanical Stabilization of High‐Voltage O3‐Type Sodium Layered Oxide Cathodes
item.description:

Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a covalent–ionic dual-pathway decoupling strategy guided by HSAB theory: Ti─O covalent frameworks suppress detrimental phase transitions, while Mg─F ionic coordination anchors lattice oxygen. This bonding regulation decouples chemo-mechanical degradation, enabling high-voltage O3-type sodium layered cathodes with 76.32% retention over 400 cycles and wide-temperature cyclability, offering a paradigm for stable high-energy-density cathodes.
🏷 O3-type layered oxide · sodium-ion battery · covalent-ionic bonding · lattice oxygen · phase transition

item.title: Carbon Nanosheets‐Supported Asymmetric Co‐B 1 N 3 for High‐Rate Potassium Ion Batteries

Carbon Energy | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in synthesizing carbon nanosheet-supported asymmetric Co-B1N3 from coal tar pitch via electrostatic adsorption and heteroatom capture. This asymmetric coordination enhances K+ adsorption, lowers diffusion resistance, and promotes inorganic-rich SEI formation, yielding high capacity (356.6 mAh g−1), excellent rate capability (141.9 mAh g−1 at 5 A g−1), and 84.5% retention after 1200 cycles, offering a strategy for high-performance potassium-ion battery anodes.

item.title: Spin‐State Engineering via Asymmetric Defects for High‐Energy‐Efficiency Li–S Batteries: Unlocking Fast Sulfur Redox Through d‐p‐p Orbital Hybridization
item.description:
با تثبیت جای خالی گوگرد به‌وسیله دوپینگ فسفر در FeS، حالت اسپین میانی آهن از طریق هیبریداسیون اوربیتالی d-p-p تنظیم شده و بازده انرژی و عمر چرخه Li-S بهبود می‌یابد.
Carbon Energy | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in a "heteroatom-pinning" strategy that stabilizes sulfur vacancies via phosphorus doping, creating asymmetric Vs–P motifs that tune Fe spin states through d-p-p orbital hybridization. This spin engineering enables fast sulfur redox, yielding exceptional durability (0.030% decay/cycle, 86.6% efficiency over 1986 cycles) and rate performance, establishing spin configuration as a key activity descriptor for rational Li–S battery design.
🏷 lithium-sulfur battery · spin-state engineering · sulfur vacancy · orbital hybridization · polysulfide conversion
